The '''Clarity Gate''' was a trapezoidal gate that was the entrance to the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]] grounds, beyond which was a tranquil courtyard which featured a small fountain. Every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was required to meditate at this gate before entering the academy grounds, usually while focusing their attention on the fountain. There were no exceptions to this rule as [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] found out during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], when she was hurrying to get a jar of [[Fizz (acid)|Fizz]] to [[Cilghal]] but was stopped from from entering the grounds by her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and told to meditate.
